Yorick is a ghost resident of your [[graveyard]]. He will appear to you occasionally after sleeping. He is the one who explains the [[corpse]] rating system and the process for [[Exhumation permission|exhuming]] bodies. He whines a lot.

After you upgrade your [[church]] you can meet him near it in the night, where he will summon lightning onto your graveyard, damaging some graves. 

==Quests==

===Get rid of that guy!===
After your first night in your bed, Yorick appears and asks you to exhume the [[corpse]] in the lower right corner of the [[graveyard]] and toss it into the [[river]], claiming that they are a jerk and should be evicted from the graveyard.

'''Note:''' You can choose any corpse, as long as you throw it into the river.

After you dig up a corpse and throw it into the river, [[Gerry]] appears and scolds you for having done so. He tells you about [[Crematorium|where]] to burn corpses. This is better than throwing them into the river, as you get a {{item|burial certificate}} for cremating them.

The following night, the ghost appears again and teaches you something about how to improve your {{Graveyard Rating}}.

===Other Cutscenes===
Later, he shows up again and tells you he is now the concierge of new souls coming into the graveyard.

On a random night after the player reaches 100 {{Graveyard Rating}}, entering the graveyard will trigger an event where Yorick will summon lightning, randomly damaging a handful of graves, primarily targeting corpses that have 1 or more {{Red Skull}}.  The event will still occur even if all buried bodies have only {{White Skull}}.


==Stranger Sins DLC==
After the player builds the Barman Dummy, Yorick will possess it. This allows the player to begin hiring him to work at the Talking Skull Tavern, serving food and drinks. 

Yorick will request that you put [[A mug of beer]] on the box shelves in the basement. It must be bronze level (no higher) to complete the task.
